problems.problem: The sienna disc's arc dies exactly into the bottle's left silhouette edge (disc right edge x=680 vs bottle left edge x=339..741), so instead of reading as a sun passing behind the flacon it reads as a半 tab welded to the bottle's left flank; the lower-right quadrant of the canvas is dead empty ochre, unbalancing the off-centre disc against the centred bottle.

Vertical rhythm is top-heavy with a void in the middle: subtitle baseline band ends at y=364, the registration rule sits at y=392, then only ~26px of air before the cap hits y=418, while an ~83px gap sits between title (bottom 267) and subtitle (top 350); the monument band feels squeezed against the product and loose internally.

The declared 'faint fine dry-brush grain' is not visibly present; the field renders as a flat digital fill, so the matte gouache paper material claim of the concept is unsupported in the final image and the backdrop reads as a plain color wall rather than a painted paper surface.

Hierarchy steps are uneven: logo (26px, tracking 6) to title (64px) jumps strongly, but title to subtitle (22px) is separated by excessive white space relative to the subtitle-to-rule-to-cap spacing, so the three-line band does not lock into one monument block; the rule at y=392 nearly collides with the cap top at y=418.

changes.value: Seamless saturated marigold ochre matte gouache paper with visible fine dry-brush grain and subtle pigment mottling, uniform diffuse frontal illumination, uninterrupted flat painted color field, empty environment
